effects.printed_clause: Once per turn: You can change 1 monster you control to face-up or face-down Defense Position, then you can return 1 monster on the field to its owner's hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A soft-once-per-turn free-chain effect selects one controlled monster at resolution, toggles face-down Defense to face-up Defense or any face-up position to face-down Defense, and only after a successful position change optionally returns any able monster on either field.

official_references.matched_structure: Changes a monster to face-down Defense Position.
Position change followed by targeting/returning a card to hand.

effects.printed_clause: You must control another Ghostrick card to activate and resolve this effect.
effects.lua_implementation: Both activation and resolution call s.poscon, which requires another face-up setcoded Ghostrick card in the controller's Monster/Spell/Trap/Field zones.

official_references.matched_structure: Requires control of another Ghostrick card for an effect to remain applicable.

effects.printed_clause: If a Level 1 Ghostrick monster activates its effect in the hand while this card is in your GY: You can Set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field.
effects.lua_implementation: The GY chain trigger Sets this card and grants the leave-field banish redirect without an unprinted hard once-per-turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Self-Sets from GY after a specified opponent/game event and redirects when leaving.
Self-Set followed by leave-field banish redirect.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: multiple copies may each respond because the exact clause has no count limit.

coverage_override.reason: Three records cover position/return effect, required other Ghostrick condition, and GY self-Set/redirect trigger.
